entities.summary: Dr. Véronique Inès Thouvenot is a medical doctor, scientific director, and specialist in public and humanitarian health with a focus in eHealth and Telemedicine since 2002. She was named in BBC's 100 women, as one of the 100 inspiring and influential women from around the world for 2019. She is co-founder of Zero Mothers Die and Fundación Millenia2025 focused on women empowerment and equality, and has held senior positions at the United Nations and the World Health Organization.
